dedupe_keys.name: openstreetmap road network fyli and vienna

description: Mike Karamousadakis and George Stergiopoulos publish separate OpenStreetMap road graphs for Fyli and Vienna. The December 2025 Zenodo deposit provides two GraphML files free under the Open Database License, with attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors. The description identifies detailed street geometries and road classifications. These files can initialise local routing, accessibility and disruption simulations without reconstructing the same regional extracts. The upstream global mapping resource is catalogued as data-openstreetmap; that parent does not explicitly identify this two-city release. Coverage is the two named areas, not a national road inventory. Extraction dates, filtering rules, graph simplification, directionality and capacity attributes are not documented on the landing page. They therefore require checking before traffic assignment or capacity analysis. Mapping completeness and temporal consistency remain uncertain. No GraphML file was downloaded or routability tested.
